note: Layer-1 regional honesty re-tag of region:inland/kzn/eastern-cape lines. Judged by content.
test: Would the line ring false in coastal Western Cape? If yes and a box fits -> tag it; if yes and no box -> HELD; else national.

rows.en: Air this clear should come with a warning: plans will be made.
rows.af: Lug so skoon, jy kan amper tot môre toe sien.

rows.en: Highveld mornings: freezing, gorgeous, zero apologies.
rows.af: Hoëveld-oggend: koud genoeg vir 'n jas, mooi genoeg dat jy nie omgee nie.

rows.en: Signal: weak. Views: unfair. Deadlines: whose?
rows.af: Berg-oggende laat jou vergeet wat 'n deadline is.

rows.en: Small-town quiet: you can actually hear yourself think. Terrifying.
rows.af: Platteland-stilte: jy kan jou eie gedagtes hoor. Skrikwekkend.

rows.en: Out here even the sun refuses to rush.
rows.af: Hier jaag niemand nie. Die son ook nie.

rows.en: Highveld winter flex: laundry dry before the kettle's even done.
rows.af: Hoëveld-winter: die wasgoed is droog voor die ketel kook.

rows.en: Karoo sky: same flawless blue for the next 400 km. Guaranteed.
rows.af: Karoo-blou: presies dieselfde perfekte kleur van hier tot môre.

rows.en: Padkos hits different under infinite sky. That's just science.
rows.af: Padkos smaak beter onder 'n lug sonder einde.

rows.en: A day so good even rush hour felt optional.
rows.af: Die dag was so mooi, selfs die verkeer het saamgespeel.

rows.en: Highveld golden hour: costs nothing, upstages everything.
rows.af: Goue uur op die Hoëveld: gratis, en steeds onbetaalbaar.

rows.en: Verandah weather. The couch will understand.
rows.af: Stoepsit-weer. Die TV kan maar wag.

rows.en: House rules: last over when the streetlights win.
rows.af: Die reëls is eenvoudig: laaste boulbeurt wanneer die straatligte aankom.

rows.en: Small town, giant sky, zero rush.
rows.af: Klein dorpie, groot lug, geen haas nie.

rows.en: Someone turned the stars up to full volume.
rows.af: Iemand het die sterre se volume opgedraai.

rows.en: City folk pay good money for this ceiling.
rows.af: Stadsmense betaal groot geld hiervoor. Hier's dit sommer verniet.

rows.en: Streetlights on early tonight, and not a single complaint.
rows.af: Die straatligte gaan vroeg aan en niemand kla nie.

rows.en: The house is colder inside than outside. Architecture is a beautiful thing.
rows.af: Die huis is kouer binne as buite. Argitektuur is 'n mooi ding.

rows.en: The dog looked out the front door, turned around, and went back to bed. Says it all.
rows.af: Die hond het by die voordeur gekyk, omgedraai, en teruggegaan bed toe. Wys jou.

rows.en: Frost on the grass, frost on the bakkie, frost on my will to live.
rows.af: Ryp op die gras, ryp op die bakkie, ryp op my moed.
rows.why: frost/ice ('frost') rings false in coastal WC

rows.en: Most beautiful time of day. Say the people who stay inside.
rows.af: Mooiste tyd van die dag. Sê die mense wat binne bly.

rows.en: Snow on the mountains means one thing: everyone is going to tell you about it today.
rows.af: Sneeu op die berge beteken een ding: almal gaan dit vandag vir jou sê.

rows.en: Two duvets and a prayer. That's the system.
rows.af: Twee duvets en 'n gebed. So oorleef ons.

rows.en: The sun is out. It means nothing. The sun is lying.
rows.af: Die son is uit. Dit beteken niks. Die son jok.

rows.en: Prettiest blue sky in the country, and it feels like a fridge with a view.
rows.af: Mooiste blou lug in die land, en dit voel soos 'n yskas met uitsig.

rows.en: Highveld winter: sunburn and frostbite achievable on the same day.
rows.af: Highveld winter: sonbrand en verkluiming op dieselfde dag moontlik.

rows.en: Joburg winter: jacket in the morning, T-shirt by two, jacket again by four.
rows.af: Joburg-winter: jas in die oggend, T-hemp teen twee, jas weer teen vier.

rows.en: Sitting in the sun, complaining about the cold. National sport.
rows.af: Sit in die son, klae oor die koue. Nasionale sport.

rows.en: So cold the frost stayed for lunch.
rows.af: So koud dat die ryp middagete gebly het.
rows.why: frost/ice ('frost') rings false in coastal WC

rows.en: Trout weather. Lovely for the fish. Character-building for the fisherman.
rows.af: Forelweer. Vir die vis is dit lekker. Vir die visserman is dit karakterbou.

rows.en: The water looks like glass. It feels like ice. Do not run the experiment.
rows.af: Die water lyk soos glas. Dit voel soos ys. Moenie eksperimenteer nie.

rows.en: The sun is leaving and taking all the degrees with it.
rows.af: Die son gaan weg en vat al die grade saam.

rows.en: You can watch the cold arriving. It's not even being subtle about it.
rows.af: Jy kan die koue sien inkom. Dit maak nie eers geheim daarvan nie.

rows.en: Woodsmoke at dusk: the Highveld's winter perfume.
rows.af: Houtrook teen skemer: die Highveld se winterparfuum.

rows.en: Somebody's driving home right now with the heater on full and the seat warmer as a bonus.
rows.af: Iemand ry nou huis toe met die verwarmer op vol en die sitplekverwarmer as bonus.

rows.en: The pass is beautiful. The pass is also the opening act for -2°C.
rows.af: Die pas is mooi. Die pas is ook -2°C se voorprogram.

rows.en: The mountain glows like a fireplace. Unfortunately it only warms the eyes.
rows.af: Die berg gloei soos 'n kaggel. Ongelukkig werk dit net vir die oë.

rows.en: The blesbok wear no scarves and file no complaints. We could learn something. We won't, but we could.
rows.af: Die blesbokke dra nie serpe nie en kla ook nie. Ons kan iets leer. Ons gaan nie, maar ons kan.

rows.en: Free State dusk: the most beautiful ten minutes of the coldest night.
rows.af: Vrystaat-skemer: die mooiste tien minute van die koudste aand.

rows.en: The stars shine brighter when it's cold. The universe's way of apologising.
rows.af: Die sterre is helderder as dit koud is. Die heelal se manier van jammer sê.

rows.en: Five minutes of stargazing. Then you run back inside. That's the deal.
rows.af: Vyf minute sterre kyk. Dan hardloop jy terug binnetoe. Dis die deal.

rows.en: The Berg is wearing snow tonight. Somewhere a farmer's dog has already moved indoors.
rows.af: Die Berg dra sneeu vanaand. Iewers is 'n boer se hond klaar in die huis.
rows.why: the Berg — E. Free State highlands

rows.en: That one little light is someone doing winter correctly: hut, fire, done.
rows.af: Daardie een liggie is iemand wat winter reg doen: hut, vuur, klaar.

rows.en: The lawn caught frost overnight. You're next.
rows.af: Die gras het ryp gevang. Jy is volgende.
rows.why: frost/ice ('frost') rings false in coastal WC

rows.en: Zero wind. Zero clouds. Zero mercy.
rows.af: Nul wind, nul wolke, nul genade.

rows.en: Somebody left the freezer door open overnight.
rows.af: Die Karoo het die verkoeler oopgelos.

rows.en: Looks like a tourism ad. Feels like the inside of a fridge.
rows.af: Joburg lyk soos 'n advertensie en voel soos 'n yskas.

rows.en: That first breath of air will wake you better than coffee.
rows.af: Daai eerste asemteug gaan jou wakker maak. Belowe.

rows.en: Even the dog's breath is showing. That's the reading.
rows.af: Die hond se asem wys ook. Dis hoe koud dit is.

rows.en: Frost on the fence, sun in your eyes, feeling in zero fingers.
rows.af: Ryp op die draad, son in die oë, gevoel in nul vingers.
rows.why: frost/ice ('frost') rings false in coastal WC

rows.en: Clear skies, open roads, running nose. The full winter set.
rows.af: Die lug is oop, die pad is oop, jou neus loop.

rows.en: The sun is doing summer. The air didn't get the memo.
rows.af: Die son skyn soos somer. Die lug het nie die memo gekry nie.

rows.en: Perfect drying weather. The washing will dry and freeze, in that order.
rows.af: Perfekte wasgoedweer. Die wasgoed gaan droog word én bevries.
rows.why: frost/ice ('dry and freeze') rings false in coastal WC

rows.en: Those sheets are coming off the line in cardboard form.
rows.af: Lakens gaan vandag in kartonvorm afgehaal word.
rows.why: frost/ice ('cardboard form') rings false in coastal WC

rows.en: Perfect rugby weather. For the spectators with blankets.
rows.af: Perfekte rugbyweer. Vir die toeskouers met komberse.

rows.en: The shady side of the field is a separate climate zone.
rows.af: Daai skadu-kant van die veld is 'n ander klimaatsone.

rows.en: The aloes are blooming because they're the only ones enjoying this.
rows.af: Die aalwyne blom, want hulle is die enigstes wat die koue geniet.
rows.why: Karoo/inland ('aloe') rings false in coastal WC

rows.en: Orange flowers, blue sky, blue lips.
rows.af: Oranje blomme, blou lug, blou lippe.

rows.en: In the sun: bearable. Two steps left: Antarctica.
rows.af: In die son: draaglik. Twee treë links: Antarktika.

rows.en: Padstal coffee is functioning as central heating today.
rows.af: Padstalkoffie werk vandag as sentrale verhitting.
rows.why: Karoo/inland ('padstal') rings false in coastal WC

rows.en: The Karoo doesn't lie about the weather. It brags about it.
rows.af: Die Karoo lieg nie oor die weer nie. Hy spog daarmee.

rows.en: The view is free. So is the feeling in your ears — gone.
rows.af: Die uitsig is gratis. Die gevoel in jou ore ook weg.

rows.en: One blanket, two people, zero shame.
rows.af: Een kombers, twee mense, geen skaamte nie.

rows.en: Not a cloud in sight. Not a degree either.
rows.af: Nie 'n wolk in sig nie. Ook nie 'n graad nie.

rows.en: The Free State sky is too big for its thermometer today.
rows.af: Die Vrystaat se lug is vandag te groot vir sy termometer.

rows.en: The sun is heading home now, taking the last three degrees with it.
rows.af: Die son gaan nou huis toe. Vat sy laaste drie grade saam.

rows.en: First star is out. First ten degrees have also left.
rows.af: Eerste ster is uit. Eerste tien grade is ook uit.

rows.en: The Karoo is opening its roof for the night. Dress warm for the show.
rows.af: Die Karoo maak nou die dak oop. Trek warm aan vir die vertoning.

rows.en: Joburg sunsets are winter's consolation prize. It's a good prize.
rows.af: Joburg se sonsondergange is winter se troosprys.

rows.en: The brighter the stars, the harder your blanket has to work.
rows.af: Hoe helderder die sterre, hoe harder werk die kombers.

rows.en: Free planetarium tonight. Admission: your toes.
rows.af: Gratis planetarium vanaand. Toegangsprys: jou tone.

rows.en: The frost has already started its shift. By dawn the lawn will be glass.
rows.af: Die ryp is klaar besig. Teen dagbreek is die grasperk 'n spieël.
rows.why: frost/ice ('frost') rings false in coastal WC

rows.en: The moon switched the mountains on. The heat, however, stays off.
rows.af: Die maan het die berge aangeskakel. Die hitte, egter, nie.

rows.en: Breathing like a dragon, view like a dream.
rows.af: Asem soos 'n draak, uitsig soos 'n droom.

rows.en: Tomorrow's first task: five minutes of windscreen scraping in your work clothes.
rows.af: Môreoggend se eerste taak: vyf minute ys krap in jou kerkklere.
rows.why: frost/ice ('windscreen scrap') rings false in coastal WC

rows.en: The cars have surrendered. They're sleeping under ice tonight.
rows.af: Die karre het klaar opgegee. Hulle slaap onder ys.
rows.why: frost/ice ('under ice') rings false in coastal WC

rows.en: Still, clear, freezing. The classic Highveld triple.
rows.af: Stil, helder, vriesend. Die klassieke Hoëveld-drieling.

rows.en: Five-star accommodation. Wait, no — five million.
rows.af: Vyf-ster akkommodasie. Nee wag — vyf miljoen.

rows.en: The plan was ten minutes. The noses tapped out after two.
rows.af: Die plan was tien minute. Die neuse het ná twee ingegee.

rows.en: The cows know exactly where they are. Which is more than the rest of us can say.
rows.af: Die koeie weet presies waar hulle is. Meer as wat ons kan sê.

rows.en: Midlands mist: the countryside's privacy setting.
rows.af: Midlands-mis: die platteland se privaatheid-instelling.

rows.en: You can't see the house. You believe the house.
rows.af: Jy sien nie die huis nie. Jy gló die huis.

rows.en: The mountains went to bed early tonight.
rows.af: Die berge het vanaand vroeg gaan slaap.

rows.en: 6am and the sun is already done warming up. That wasn't a warm-up, that was a warning.
rows.af: 06:00 en die son is klaar klaar met opwarm. Dit was nie 'n opwarming nie, dit was 'n waarskuwing.

rows.en: The day hasn't even started yet and it's already winning.
rows.af: Die dag het nog nie eers begin nie en hy wen alreeds.

rows.en: Drink your coffee fast. By seven it's soup.
rows.af: Drink jou koffie gou. Teen sewe is dit sop.

rows.en: If it feels like this now, second break is going to be a survival sport.
rows.af: As dit nóú al so voel, gaan tweede pouse 'n oorlewingsport wees.

rows.en: Long pants with the uniform was a gamble today. Strength, my child.
rows.af: Skooldrag met 'n langbroek was vandag 'n gok. Sterkte, my kind.

rows.en: 6:30 and the tar is already considering melting.
rows.af: 06:30 en die teer dink al aan smelt.

rows.en: Walk now or don't walk at all. The Lowveld gives you until seven.
rows.af: Stap nou of stap glad nie. Die Laeveld gee jou tot sewe-uur.

rows.en: The birds have already gone quiet. They know something.
rows.af: Die voëls het klaar stil geraak. Hulle weet iets.

rows.en: Today's workout: car to aircon.
rows.af: Vandag se oefensessie: van die kar tot by die aircon.

rows.en: Everyone running now will be bragging about it by lunch. That's the whole point.
rows.af: Almal wat nou draf, gaan teen middagete daaroor spog. Dis die hele punt.

rows.en: The 5:30 runners aren't fitter than us. They're just smarter.
rows.af: Die 05:30-drawwers is nie fikser as ons nie. Hulle is net slimmer.

rows.en: Even the sun got up early to beat the traffic.
rows.af: Selfs die son het vroeg opgestaan om die verkeer te klop.

rows.en: Even the dog checked the forecast and went straight back to bed.
rows.af: Selfs die hond het die voorspelling gecheck en teruggegaan bed toe.

rows.en: The windpomp is dead still. Even the wind isn't coming in to work today.
rows.af: Die windpomp staan doodstil. Nie eers die wind wil vandag werk nie.
rows.why: Karoo/inland ('windpomp') rings false in coastal WC

rows.en: Shade-hunting season officially opens at seven.
rows.af: Skaduwee-jagseisoen maak amptelik om sewe-uur oop.

rows.en: 35 in the shade. In the sun, nobody's counting anymore.
rows.af: 35 in die skadu. In die son tel niemand meer nie.

rows.en: Today's plan is the stoep. That's the entire plan.
rows.af: Die plan vir vandag is die stoep. Dis die hele plan.

rows.en: Move slowly. Speak slowly. Survive.
rows.af: Beweeg stadig. Praat stadig. Oorleef.

rows.en: Even the impala are standing in the shade rethinking their choices.
rows.af: Selfs die rooibokke staan in die skadu en heroorweeg hul keuses.

rows.en: Lowveld summer: you don't sweat, you melt with dignity.
rows.af: Laeveld-somer: jy sweet nie, jy smelt met waardigheid.

rows.en: The bushveld is on silent mode today. Everyone. Everything.
rows.af: Die bosveld is vandag op stille modus. Almal. Alles.

rows.en: Watermelon isn't dessert. It's first aid.
rows.af: Waatlemoen is nie nagereg nie. Dis noodhulp.

rows.en: Lunch moved outside because inside is hotter than outside. Nobody can explain it.
rows.af: Middagete het buitetoe getrek, want binne is warmer as buite. Niemand kan dit verklaar nie.

rows.en: 7pm and still 30 degrees. The Karoo doesn't make mistakes, only statements.
rows.af: 19:00 en steeds 30 grade. Die Karoo maak nie foute nie, net stellings.

rows.en: The rocks will be handing out today's heat all night. Free of charge.
rows.af: Die klippe gaan vannag nog die dag se hitte uitdeel. Verniet.

rows.en: Sunset is the Karoo's way of apologising.
rows.af: Sonsondergang is die Karoo se manier van jammer sê.

rows.en: The first breeze of the day has just arrived. Give it a round of applause.
rows.af: Die eerste briesie van die dag het nou net opgedaag. Gee hom applous.

rows.en: Sundowners aren't a luxury in the Lowveld. They're medical.
rows.af: Sundowners is nie 'n luukse in die Laeveld nie. Dis medies.

rows.en: The day tried to finish us. We're drinking to that now.
rows.af: Die dag het ons probeer opeet. Ons drink nou daarop.

rows.en: The sprinkler is supposedly for the lawn. Look who's all standing in the water.
rows.af: Die sproeier is kamma vir die gras. Kyk wie staan almal in die water.

rows.en: Adults 'just taking a garden stroll' exactly where the sprinkler sprays. Coincidence, nè.
rows.af: Grootmense wat 'net deur die tuin stap' presies waar die sproeier spuit. Toeval, nè.

rows.en: In the Karoo this isn't rain. It's a celebrity appearance.
rows.af: In die Karoo is dit nie reën nie. Dis 'n verskyning.

rows.en: Even the sheep are standing still for this one.
rows.af: Selfs die skape staan stil vir hierdie een.

rows.en: Somebody's birthday-candle wish just paid out.
rows.af: Iemand het reggewens by die verjaarsdagkoek.

rows.en: Rain on a farm isn't weather. It's a salary falling from the sky.
rows.af: Reën op 'n plaas is nie weer nie. Dis 'n salaris wat val.

rows.en: Somewhere a farmer is doing a small private dance nobody's allowed to see.
rows.af: Iewers doen 'n boer nou 'n klein dansie wat niemand mag sien nie.

rows.en: Wet tar at sunrise. That's not a smell, that's heritage.
rows.af: Nat teer by sonsopkoms. Dis nie 'n reuk nie, dis 'n erfenis.

rows.en: Post-storm Highveld air should be bottled and sold overseas.
rows.af: Die Hooglandlug ná reën behoort in 'n botteltjie verkoop te word.

rows.en: Joburg rain keeps a diary: 2pm sharp, maximum drama, no apologies.
rows.af: Joburg se reën hou dagboek: 14:00, stiptelik, vol drama.

rows.en: Twenty minutes of opera, then the sun acts like nothing happened.
rows.af: Twintig minute se opera, dan maak die son of niks gebeur het nie.

rows.en: Other cities get weather. Joburg gets a production.
rows.af: Ander stede kry weer. Joburg kry 'n vertoning.

rows.en: Two drops on a windscreen and the whole N1 forgets everything it ever learned.
rows.af: Twee druppels op die voorruit en die hele N1 se geheue is skoon gewas.

rows.en: You smell Highveld rain before you see it. That's the trailer.
rows.af: Jy ruik Hoëveldse reën voor jy hom sien. Dis die lokprent.

rows.en: The veld already knows. The veld always knows first.
rows.af: Die veld weet reeds. Die veld weet altyd eerste.
rows.why: Karoo/inland ('veld') rings false in coastal WC

rows.en: Joburg rains for twenty minutes, then paints the sky like nothing happened.
rows.af: Joburg reën twintig minute en verf dan die lug asof niks gebeur het nie.

rows.en: The storm was the performance. This is the bow.
rows.af: Die storm was die opvoering. Dít is die buiging.

rows.en: Distant lightning and a warm mug: best channel on television.
rows.af: Weerlig in die verte, koffie in die hand — beste kanaal op televisie.

rows.en: In the Karoo you watch rain the way other people watch rugby.
rows.af: In die Karoo kyk jy reën soos ander mense rugby kyk.

rows.en: It's still fifty kilometres away and the stoep is already sold out.
rows.af: Dis nog vyftig kilometer weg en die stoep is klaar vol.
rows.why: watching rain approach 50km off — inland big-sky, false in coastal WC

rows.en: Rain on a tin roof: the official national lullaby.
rows.af: Reën op 'n sinkdak: die land se amptelike slaapliedjie.

rows.en: Free fireworks, no tickets, best seats in the house.
rows.af: Gratis vuurwerke. Geen kaartjies. Beste sitplekke in die huis.

rows.en: The Highveld doesn't do subtle, and honestly we're grateful.
rows.af: Die Hoëveld hou nie van subtiel nie en ons is dankbaar.

rows.en: The sky woke up in a mood.
rows.af: Die lug het wakker geword met 'n houding.

rows.en: 6am and the sky has already called a meeting.
rows.af: 06:00 en die hemel het reeds 'n vergadering belê.

rows.en: Not even coffee is fixing this mood.
rows.af: Nie eens koffie gaan dié bui regmaak nie.

rows.en: Rusks first. Panic later.
rows.af: Beskuit eerste. Paniek later.

rows.en: Free IMAX this morning, boet.
rows.af: Gratis IMAX vanoggend, boet.

rows.en: The dog has already booked his spot under the bed.
rows.af: Die hond het klaar sy plek onder die bed bespreek.

rows.en: Sunrise chose drama today.
rows.af: Die sonsopkoms het vanoggend op drama besluit.

rows.en: Somewhere a farmer is very chuffed right now.
rows.af: Iewers is 'n boer nou baie in sy noppies.

rows.en: Even the water is holding its breath.
rows.af: Selfs die water hou sy asem op.

rows.en: Gorgeous, but I trust it zero percent.
rows.af: Pragtig, maar ek vertrou dit vir niks.

rows.en: The calm before the group chat explodes.
rows.af: Dis die stilte voor die groepsgesprek ontplof.

rows.en: Drive now, wonder later.
rows.af: Ry nou, wonder later.

rows.en: The horizon looks like a movie finale.
rows.af: Die horison lyk soos 'n fliek se slottoneel.

rows.en: Neighbourhood watch has a new agenda: the sky.
rows.af: Buurtwag se nuwe agenda: die lug.

rows.en: Nobody is being on time today.
rows.af: Niemand gaan vandag betyds wees nie.

rows.en: Those aren't clouds, that's a trailer.
rows.af: Dis nie wolke nie, dis 'n lokprent.

rows.en: Today's forecast: special effects.
rows.af: Vandag se voorspelling: verhoogeffekte.

rows.en: Someone cranked the contrast way too high.
rows.af: Iemand het die kontras heeltemal te hoog gestel.

rows.en: The smell of rain has already RSVP'd.
rows.af: Die reuk van reën het klaar ge-RSVP.

rows.en: The braai continues. So does the show.
rows.af: Die braai gaan aan. Die vertoning ook.

rows.en: Unplug the TV — it's tradition.
rows.af: Onthou om die TV se prop uit te trek — dis tradisie.

rows.en: Free fireworks, no tickets needed.
rows.af: Gratis vuurwerke, geen kaartjies nodig nie.

rows.en: Midnight and the sky is showing off.
rows.af: Middernag en die lug wys af.

rows.en: Sleep is cancelled, but look at that shot.
rows.af: Slaap is gekanselleer, maar kyk net daai skoot.

rows.en: Thunder at volume ten, the neighbour's dog at eleven.
rows.af: Donderweer op volume tien, die buurman se hond op elf.

rows.en: The farm's best TV channel.
rows.af: Die plaas se beste TV-kanaal.

rows.en: Every flash is a photo nobody takes in time.
rows.af: Elke weerligstraal is 'n foto wat niemand betyds neem nie.

rows.en: Gqeberha, we know. We know.
rows.af: Gqeberha, ons weet. Ons wéét.

rows.en: The Friendly City never asked to be the Windy City, and yet.
rows.af: Die Vriendelike Stad het nie gevra om die Winderige Stad te wees nie, en tog.

rows.en: Cape Town sends solidarity. And a spare cap.
rows.af: Kaapstad stuur sterkte. En 'n ekstra pet.

rows.en: Jeffreys Bay: where the wind warms up before its Cape Town shift.
rows.af: Jeffreysbaai: waar die wind oefen voor sy Kaapse skof.

rows.en: Gqeberha doesn't sleep, it just holds on.
rows.af: Gqeberha slaap nie, dit hou net vas.
